title: Validate your App Intents adoption with AppIntentsTesting
description: Meet AppIntentsTesting, a new framework for validating your App Intents through the same infrastructure used by Siri, Shortcuts, and Spotlight. Discover how to execute intents, inspect results, and test entities and queries — all without requiring UI automation. Find out how to verify integrations like View annotations and Spotlight indexing, helping you catch bugs early in your development workflow.
